sections.project_overview: Redevelopment of a heritage site into a modern care home facility while preserving historic character.

heritage_preservation.goal: Respect and retain key architectural features of the original building.
methods: Integration of historic design elements into new structures

care_home_design.focus: Provide high-quality residential and healthcare facilities.

community_benefits.impact: Enhances local area by combining heritage conservation with modern living needs.

sustainability.approach: Fabric-first strategy to minimize embodied carbon.

landscape_design.purpose: Improve resident wellbeing and integrate with surrounding environment.
